caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled "Fluency" presents a comparison of fluency scores for four different prompt variations (V1, V2, V3, V4) of the HDM model in the context of humour translation, as evaluated by the GEMBA-SQM metric. The horizontal axis displays the four prompt variants (V1, V2, V3, V4) in sequential order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the fluency score, ranging from 97.0 to 100.0 in increments of 0.5, with dashed gridlines for reference. Each bar corresponds to one variant and is color-coded: V1 is dark blue, V2 is orange, V3 is green, and V4 is purple. The bars are arranged in descending order of fluency score, with V1 achieving the highest score of 99.15, followed by V3 at 98.5, V2 at 98.2, and V4 at 97.7. The values are explicitly labeled above each bar, and the chart visually emphasizes the performance differences among the variants, with V1 significantly outperforming the others. There is no grouping or stacking; each variant is represented by a single, distinct bar.
